This template links to an audio file for quick listening.  It is meant to be used inline with text where there is no need to further explain the IPA, as in a phonology article. When the article does not explain the IPA, a dedicated IPA template should be used: IPA-en for English, and IPA-xx for other languages, where the 'xx' is replaced with the ISO code for the language (fr French, de German, es Spanish, ru Russian, etc.). 

== Usage ==

<code><nowiki>{{Audio-IPA|name of sound file|IPA notation}}</nowiki></code>

Example:

:<code><nowiki>Swedish: åka {{Audio-IPA|sv-åka.ogg|[ˈoːka]}}, 'travel', 'go'</nowiki></code>

gives this:

:Swedish: åka {{Audio-IPA|sv-åka.ogg|[ˈoːka]}}, 'travel', 'go'

If you include a lang parameter, it will specify which subcategory of [[:Category:Articles including recorded pronunciations]] to place the article in, as in:

<code><nowiki>{{Audio-IPA|name of sound file|IPA notation|lang=Language}}</nowiki></code>

Setting {{para|help|no}} disables the "help/info" links. If this is done the template {{tlx|inline audio}} ''must'' be shown on the page.

== See also ==
{{Audio templates}}
*{{tl|IPA-en}}, {{tl|IPA-all}}, and other IPA templates, which accept audio files and link to keys that explain the IPA.
